pages.name: Customer Documents API and Events
pages.page_text:
Customer Documents API and Events
The Customer Documents API allows customers to retrieve document types, download document metadata, and files from If Login Industrial System. Additionally, customers can set up a webhook to receive events related to document updates.
Fetch all relevant documents for your use case and build flows to store them efficiently.
Ensure policies and invoices are available in your systems as they are published.
The Retrieve Customer Documents API allows customers to retrieve document types and document metadata to fetch files from If Login Industrial System. Additionally, consumers of the API can set up a webhook to receive events related to document updates. Customer Documents API seamlessly integrates with broker, customer, or third-party systems, accessing document metadata and downloading documents with ease. Real-time updates: By setting up a webhook, API consumers can receive real-time updates on document updates, ensuring they always have the most up-to-date information. The API allows for retrieving documents from the system on a large scale. Consumers can also download document metadata, including information about the document, policy number, company, publishing date etc. In addition, customers can download files by providing the DocumentId as an input parameter. Receive Customer Document events Receive Customer Documents events when new documents are created or existing ones are changed to secure an up-to-date archive of policies and invoices. Additional information: The API is intended for brokers or enterprises to track updates, create policies and fetch them to use in internal systems. Examples can be a broker fetching all relevant client's policies or an entreprise needing to archive all policies or invoices throughout the year. Technical documentation: The client credentials flow/grant is designed for server-to-server (backend-to-backend) communication. Therefore, the client must agree to ONLY use backend-to-backend communication. The client credentials used in this API can NEVER be used by mobile or web applications. Technical requirements: Authentication: Every customer should have an active user in If Login Industrial. Customers must have a valid API key to access the Retrieve Customer Documents API. Webhook: Customers must set up a webhook to receive real-time updates on document updates. The webhook endpoint should be set on event service subscription activation.

pages.name: Manage Direct Compensation Claims Person Finland
pages.page_text:
Manage Direct Compensation Claims Person Finland
Instant confirmation at checkout on whether the treatment costs is covered
Partners ensure an easy payment flow for their customer
If aims to ensure that customers who fall ill can focus entirely on their recovery instead of dealing with lengthy forms to claim compensation. The Manage Direct Compensation Claims Person API enables If’s Finnish healthcare partners to request compensation for treatment costs directly at the clinic’s checkout.
The targeted segment for this service is Finnish indivduals with a private health insurance, covering both accident and illness. Unique Selling Points Customers who fall ill or have an accident receive instant confirmation at checkout on whether their treatment costs are covered by If. Partners can offer a seamless checkout experience while ensuring they receive direct compensation for treatments provided to If’s customers. The Manage Direct Compensation Claims Person FI API is available to all current and future If healthcare partners, both for in-clinic services and their supplementary digital platforms (e.g., mobile apps). Use Cases An adult falls ill, and the clinic clerk requests compensation for the treatment. If fully covers the claim, so the customer doesn’t have to pay. A child has an accident, and the clinic clerk requests compensation for the treatment. If fully covers the claim, so the customer doesn’t have to pay. An adult falls ill, and the clinic clerk requests compensation for the treatment. If provides partial compensation, and the customer pays the deductible at the clinic.

Personal Insurance Recommendation Norway
Enhance Norwegian customers knowledge about their personal insurance need. By adding a few inputs, the customer will get a recommendation suited for their life situation.
Offers a personal recommendation based on the customer’s life situation
Makes sure that your customers are correctly insured
There are 3 APIs in our personal insurance recommendation API family
The major ones are: 1. Admin-Recommendation-PersonalInsurance-NO 2. AnalyseImpact-PersonalInsurance-NO The third one is the support API ListOptions-PersonalInsurances-NO that provides options for a couple of the input parameters to the two major APIs. Admin-Recommendation-PersonalInsurance-NO The API requires the customer to authenticate with Bank ID, and then allows the customer to submit certain parameters (see input data below), and to receive recommended personal insurance products and insurance amounts. Input data The options for the input data fall into two categories: The input parameters for the education level, marital status and number of children accept a defined set of values that are specified in the swagger for the API. The input parameters for the work category, income, and total household debt ranges also accept a limited set of values. The values are, however, not predefined, rather the ListOptions-PersonalInsurances-NO API returns the options for each of the input parameters. AnalyseImpact-PersonalInsurance-NO The API helps the customer understand how they are affected in case something bad happens and how personal insurance reduces the economic impact: You may calculate the recommended life insurance amount based on the annual income and total household debt. You may calculate the loss of income in case the customer is no longer able to work, taking into account payouts from public welfare and other sources - when insured and when not insured. Input data The options for the input data fall into three categories: The input parameter for the age is any positive number. The input parameter for the number of children accepts a defined set of values that are specified in the swagger for the API. The input parameter for the income and total household debt ranges also accepts a limited set of values. The values aret, however, not predefined, rather the ListOptions-PersonalInsurances-NO API returns the options for each of the input parameters.

Travelling customers on business and leasure trips have high expectations in case they need help while travelling. The variety of incidents stretches from sickness to lost luggage. Especially when becoming sick when travelling the needs of the customers might be very urgent. In order to meet the needs and expectations of customers If works with external partners to guide and help them to the right health service and provide treatment. To simplify the work for our partners when registering travel claims at If the "Register travel claim" api is provided.
By using the " Register travel claim" API partners only need to register a certain set of data to the api which will then route the claim to the correct claim system in If. The partner will use a set of data parameters such as SSN to check coverage and register the claim and all claim details in the relevant If systems. Our partners integrate to only one API from If, which we maintain, develop further with more data, removing the need of maintenance and development on our partners side. Using the " Register travel claim" API will lead to better customer journey for claimants due to the immediate registration of claims into integrated systems. Hence, if the customer is first in contact with the partner to register the claim, the claim will very quickly be available to If, the partner and customer in If's digital channels.

The Buy Home Insurance Sweden API enables digital partners to generate quotes and complete policy purchases for three levels of home insurance coverage. The API is designed for fast, reliable integration and supports both real‑time quoting and policy issuance.
Just add a social security number and living address. Answer a few questions and you will be presented with a price and possibility to buy the insurance.
if icon symbol curve-directions

What’s Included in Buy Home Insurance?
A home insurance policy is a package that contains many important types of protection. Below is a concise summary of what the basic coverage includes.
Protection for Your Belongings — Inside and Outside the Home Home insurance covers items you own, rent, or borrow for private use. You can receive compensation if they are damaged due to events such as fire, burglary, or water leakage. Compensation if Your Home Becomes Uninhabitable If your home is damaged to the extent that you can no longer live in it, you may receive compensation for additional costs related to alternative accommodation and storage for up to two years. 45 Days of Travel Insurance All our home insurance policies include 45 days of travel protection. You are covered for medical expenses if you become ill or injured abroad, as well as if you are robbed or have property stolen. Support for Identity Theft and Assault You can receive personal advice on how to prevent identity theft. If your identity is stolen, you also get help to limit the damage and legal assistance to challenge false claims. If you are subjected to robbery, assault, or abuse, you may receive compensation in the form of a fixed amount. Crisis Therapy If you experience a crisis reaction after a robbery, assault, burglary, or fire, you may receive compensation for crisis therapy. We cover up to 10 therapy sessions with a licensed psychologist, up to SEK 1,500 per session. Liability and Legal Protection If someone demands damages from you, we investigate whether you are legally liable and pay any compensation up to SEK 5 million. You may also receive compensation for attorney and court costs up to SEK 300,000 if you become involved in a dispute that may go to district court. Property Quote & Buy APIs Norway
These API products offer the possibility to buy insurance for the valuables of a home (householder insurance), or can be bought as a bundle for house insurance and its valuables (property insurance).
It’s super smooth to buy our Householder insurance. We just need the address to find your price.

The Get Quote and Buy API is suitable for customers who know what they need and just want to get the price calculation and purchase done.
The Property and Householder Quote & Buy API can be implemented and utilized by our property partners as well as partners in other fields.
Offer householder insurance from If - Innboforsikring to have your customers' valuables and house contents insured. The Householder insurance product is available to everyone who wishes to insure their valuables and house contents. With a continual focus on improving product coverage and the purchase process, Householder (Innboforsikring) is an attractive and relevant product to offer directly to your visitors and clients. Here is an example of how the Norwegian Postal Services (Posten) has used this API product. The Householder insurance includes coverage for moving damages, pest control, identity theft, and rental insurance. Offer Property insurance ( Husforsikring and Innboforsikring ) from If to cover both the house and the valuables (content) of the house. This API uses the address of the property and the customer as input. It requires a quote for property insurance to be created (through the Quote Property Insurance NO API). It takes the quote ID and contact information of the customer as input. If the purchase is accepted, the insurance is added to a policy in the Norwegian private core system and details on the insurance is returned. This API is for the Norwegian market only. This API provides texts that explain what the coverage options for the householder and homeowner insurances cover. Benefits These APIs let a visitor calculate price and purchase insurance while staying on our partners’ platforms, such as websites and apps. The APIs quickly find the exact price for a given potential customer utilizing If’s core systems, the same as if.no webshop. If Quote & Buy APIs will interest our partners within housing development and can be included in premium packages when your customer is in the market for an apartment or a house. These APIs are available for the Norwegian market only. If offers similar APIs in other Nordic countries as well.
